lines: The shadow by the gate won't like this smoke.
dialogue_beat1_pickup.speaker: apprentice

lines: The patient won't last the week without a cure.
You know the charm. Nine herbs. Go.
Start in the garden — mugwort first. It wards off what lurks by the gate.
dialogue_level01_intro.speaker: witch

lines: Nine gathered. Pound them to salve, as the charm bids.
Lay it on — and let the wound close.
dialogue_level01_outro.speaker: witch
